<h1 id="arch-glacor-hybrid-meleemage-3000-enrage" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>Arch-Glacor: Hybrid Melee/Mage (3000%+ enrage)</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/nRwTsLjidK.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>This guide is aimed at players looking to kill Arch-Glacor at </nowiki><strong><nowiki>3000-4000%</nowiki></strong><nowiki> Enrage and assumes strong underlying knowledge of all information presented in </nowiki><span><nowiki>#unknown-channel</nowiki></span><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>The Arch-Glacor is </nowiki><strong><nowiki>not</nowiki></strong><nowiki> affected by Slayer tasks in hard mode.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>

</nowiki>

<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Have </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/903244090953588787.png?v=1" alt="ezk" title="ezk" kind="icon" /><nowiki> equipped as often as possible while meleeing for Flamebound Rival damage reduction</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Keep </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090641879050.png?v=1" alt="smokecloud" title="smokecloud" kind="icon" /><nowiki> applied while </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1" alt="gsunshine" title="gsunshine" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Don't overspend </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478080383554945044.png?v=1" alt="bloodlust" title="bloodlust" kind="icon" /><nowiki> stacks before Glacyte Minions during </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1" alt="berserk" title="berserk" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, needed for </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1" alt="cane" title="cane" kind="icon" /><nowiki> cooldown refund</nowiki></p>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="general-rotations"><ins><nowiki>General Rotations</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>As a general rule, it is better to keep your hybrid rotation rolling even in the middle of mechanics. If your buffs run out while clearing Glacyte Minions, simply swap styles right then. If Pillars are currently happening, put up your buffs (without dying) anyway. This helps to ensure that you're spending minimal time outside of buffs for mechanics that can happen somewhat unpredictably.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>For </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Arms (Exposed Core)</nowiki></strong><nowiki> specifically, if your buffs are close to running out while the ice is creeping in, just swap styles early to make sure you're not still building as the mechanic begins.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>First Mechanic:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Glacyte Minions: finish applying necessary debuffs first, then </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1400511651014250596.png?v=1" alt="tumekenslight" title="tumekenslight" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062908767211640.png?v=1" alt="chaosroar" title="chaosroar" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1" alt="cane" title="cane" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1" alt="cane" title="cane" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (until cleared)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Arms: finish applying necessary debuffs first, then </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1" alt="overpower" title="overpower" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062908767211640.png?v=1" alt="chaosroar" title="chaosroar" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1" alt="cane" title="cane" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448697873603498045.png?v=1" alt="varanussmercy" title="varanussmercy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879439069184.png?v=1" alt="punish" title="punish" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (until cleared)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Cannon: make sure </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879053062146.png?v=1" alt="pulverise" title="pulverise" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/567727986409734145.png?v=1" alt="enfeeble" title="enfeeble" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is applied + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1" alt="anti" title="anti" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1" alt="powerburstofvitality" title="powerburstofvitality" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Flurry: make sure </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879053062146.png?v=1" alt="pulverise" title="pulverise" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/567727986409734145.png?v=1" alt="enfeeble" title="enfeeble" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is applied + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1" alt="reflect" title="reflect" kind="icon" /><nowiki> if needed</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>

<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Make sure to </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/791281588792590336.png?v=1" alt="caroming4" title="caroming4" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063106914779166.png?v=1" alt="gchain" title="gchain" kind="icon" /></p>

<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Watch </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478080383554945044.png?v=1" alt="bloodlust" title="bloodlust" kind="icon" /><nowiki> stacks, need 4 for full cooldown reset on </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1" alt="cane" title="cane" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1" alt="reflect" title="reflect" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541278264393729.png?v=1" alt="debil" title="debil" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is used because the Flamebound Rival damage reduction is lost while </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1400511651014250596.png?v=1" alt="tumekenslight" title="tumekenslight" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is equipped</nowiki></p>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="defensive-usage"><nowiki>Defensive Usage</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ At higher enrage, you will want to prioritise defensives as follows,</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Frost Cannon</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1" alt="anti" title="anti" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1" alt="DeflectMage" title="DeflectMage" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1" alt="powerburstofvitality" title="powerburstofvitality" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541278264393729.png?v=1" alt="debil" title="debil" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1" alt="reflect" title="reflect" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (only one is needed)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1" alt="res" title="res" kind="icon" /><nowiki> a hit if needed</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Exposed Core</nowiki></strong><nowiki> (Arms): </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1" alt="devo" title="devo" kind="icon" /><nowiki> if it goes too long, rarely needed</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Glacyte Minions</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1" alt="reflect" title="reflect" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541278264393729.png?v=1" alt="debil" title="debil" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Flurry</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1" alt="disrupt" title="disrupt" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1" alt="res" title="res" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1" alt="reflect" title="reflect" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541278264393729.png?v=1" alt="debil" title="debil" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1" alt="reflect" title="reflect" kind="icon" /><nowiki> does decent damage at higher enrage)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Pillars of Ice</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258546970624.png?v=1" alt="prep" title="prep" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1" alt="freedom" title="freedom" kind="icon" /><nowiki> for adrenaline</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
